title: 1.4 Where my family lives
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people’s habits.
goal: Introduce your aunt, uncle and cousin and say where each of them lives, with he/she and lives.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 1.4-1.6: the family grows to aunt, uncle and cousin. It adds no new grammar relationship: 1.2's he/she -s returns on a new verb, lives (My aunt lives in Canada. She lives in Canada.), with A1's countries and lives with + a known family word.
prerequisite: A1 1.4-1.6 family words (grandparents), 1.9 Who is he?, 2.5 this, 3.7-3.8 Mexico, Canada and the United States, 3.10 my; A1+ 1.2 he/she + -s.
speaking_outcome: A clear /z/ at the end of lives and the stressed first syllable of uncle and cousin, inside the complete sentence. Do not require native-like speed.
